info.name: Committed Platform
info.description:
Full API test collection for the Committed Learning Management System.

## Setup
1. Make sure Docker containers are running (`docker compose up --build postgres-db gateway core -d`)
2. The collection uses variables for base URLs and tokens — no manual copy-pasting needed.
3. Run requests in order within each folder for best results.

## Architecture
- **Gateway** (Java Spring Boot) — port 8080 — authentication, JWT, routing
- **Core** (PHP Symfony) — port 8000 — user management, business logic
- **PostgreSQL** — port 5432 — shared database
